estimand.primary_prefix: first 4096 canonical generated token ids or earlier EOS
estimand.source_unit: deterministic sentence/clause unit within the frozen prefix
estimand.denominator: number of deterministic source units in that task-checkpoint prefix
estimand.missingness: missing or malformed annotations remain missing and never enter the denominator as negative labels

validation_stage.selection_rule: within each frozen category, sort tasks by sha256('p5-generic-validation-2026-08-09|' + stable_task_id) and select the first two
validation_stage.selection_timing: after the Phase-2 manifest is hash-bound but before any annotation response is inspected
validation_stage.reuse_if_passes: the 100 validation rows remain part of the 500-row study under the identical protocol; they are not regenerated or rescored
validation_stage.held_out_rule: do not start unless the operational gate passes

operational_gate.fail_action: stop before the 400 held-out rows; preserve missingness; diagnose and propose a new versioned validation rather than silently retrying under a changed protocol

non_retryable: parser/schema failure after a non-empty model response
transport_and_retry.retry_identity: identical model, request bytes, prompt template, source units, output limit, and parser
transport_and_retry.raw_response_text_persistence: hash plus minimum sanitized diagnostic envelope; any retained text must follow the approved data policy

eligible_only_if_all: annotation binds to the exact canonical shared-generation row hash
annotation binds to the exact P5 4096-token-or-EOS prefix hash
the complete P5 prefix is annotated rather than only an A4/window subset
deterministic source-unit segmentation version and source-unit hashes match P5
six-label ontology and four endpoint derivations match P5
builder model/revision, prompt template, parser, evidence contract, and missingness contract are hash-bound
no Phase-2 causal-family outcome is disclosed before its gate permits it
phase2_annotation_reuse.if_ineligible: reuse the raw generation only and run a separately authorized P5 annotation pass

human_audit.selection: four checkpoint-blind rows per role, balanced across categories and chosen before automated labels are opened
human_audit.boundary: absence of this audit requires builder-annotator-scored wording

required_before_execution: Phase-2 manifest, canonical shared-generation, row, shard, and prefix hashes
P5-owned generation manifest and row hashes
exact annotation model/revision, prompt, parser, envelope, retry, and evidence hashes
exact validation task IDs and selection hash
calibrated request count and hard API cost ceiling
explicit owner authorization for the exact hash-bound validation stage
